$comment: SEC-01 baseline. Every entry here is a credential that IS ALREADY IN GIT
HISTORY and cannot be removed without rewriting it. The allowlist exists so
that the history secret scan fails on anything NEW while the known set is
pending the coordinated purge -- it is not an acceptance of these values.
Entries are keyed by sha256[:16] of the credential value. The value itself
appears nowhere in this repository, this file, or any CI log; the digest
identifies it for rotation tracking without disclosing it.
DELETE THIS FILE'S known_exposures ARRAY IMMEDIATELY AFTER
scripts/security/purge_history_secrets.sh RUNS. An empty array is the
post-purge steady state: the history scan then blocks on every finding.
Removal is verified by `scan_secrets.py --mode history`, which must report
Allowlisting a NEW value is a security decision, not a build fix. Only add
an entry for a confirmed false positive, and only with a named reviewer.
